name: Suspicious Service Installed
description:
Detects installation of NalDrv or PROCEXP152 services via registry-keys to non-system32 folders.
Both services are used in the tool Ghost-In-The-Logs (https://github.com/bats3c/Ghost-In-The-Logs), which uses KDU (https://github.com/hfiref0x/KDU)
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Other legimate tools using this service names and drivers. Note - clever attackers may easily bypass this detection by just renaming the services. Therefore just Medium-level and don't rely on it.
query: (registry.path:(HKLM\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\NalDrv\\ImagePath OR HKLM\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\PROCEXP152\\ImagePath)) AND (NOT ((process.executable:(*\\procexp64.exe OR *\\procexp.exe OR *\\procmon64.exe OR *\\procmon.exe OR *\\handle.exe OR *\\handle64.exe)) AND winlog.event_data.Details:*\\WINDOWS\\system32\\Drivers\\PROCEXP152.SYS*))
